title: Apply for a firewood permit
summary: This page provides information and steps on how to apply for a permit to collect firewood for personal use from a state forest in NSW.
intro: If you'd like to collect firewood for personal use from a state forest within NSW, you'll need to apply for a permit.
who_can_apply: Permits and timber must be paid for in advance, and you must comply with the conditions on the permit.

how_to_steps.text: Create a new account, sign in to your existing account, or checkout without registering an account.

more_info.text: carry your permit at all times and show it to Forestry Corporation officers if requested
you're only allowed to take fallen timber, and need to stick to collection limits
only collect firewood from the mapped area attached to your permit
record your collection on your permit before you leave
if needed, you can retrieve a copy of your last valid firewood permit online
firewood cannot be collected from NSW national parks except if you have a Riverina domestic firewood collection permit.

Firewood policy – Office of Environment and Heritage

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to collect firewood?
faqs.a: Yes, if you plan to collect firewood for personal use from a state forest within NSW, you must apply for a permit.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the permit?
faqs.a: You will need your vehicle registration number, your driver licence number, pensioner number (if applicable), and a credit card.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the firewood permit?
faqs.a: You can apply by selecting 'Apply online', entering the required information, and completing the online application.
